description: Seeded random streams that give the same numbers on every platform and .NET version: PCG32 with forkable sub-streams and stable string hashing, for procedural generation.

A full-featured port of the Lark parsing toolkit to .NET: Lark EBNF grammars, Earley/LALR(1)/CYK parsers, basic/contextual/dynamic lexers, tree building, transformers and visitors, plus a Roslyn source generator that turns a grammar into a type-safe parser.

General helper library for Crestron SIMPL# and SIMPL# Pro control systems. Provides IP communications (TCP, SSH, UDP, Telnet, WebSockets, WOL), display power management, level ramping, event scheduling, file operations, math utilities, and SIMPL+ integration adapters.
